pob.text: Instead[b][a], you shall eat it before Yahweh your God in the place that Yahweh your God will choose—you and your son and your daughter and your male servant and your female servant and the Levite who is within your gates—and you shall rejoice before Yahweh your God in all to which you put your hand.

pob.text: Be careful that you do not forsake the Levite all your days on your land[a][b].

public_domain_references.kjv: Take heed to thyself that thou forsake not the Levite as long as thou livest upon the earth.
public_domain_references.brenton: Take heed to thyself that thou do not desert the Levite all the time that thou livest upon the earth.

pob.text: When the LORD your God enlarges your territory, as he has promised you, and you say, “I want to eat meat,” because you crave to eat meat, you may eat meat according to all the desire of your soul.

spob.text: When the LORD your God expands your territory, as he promised you, and you say, “I want to eat meat,” because you crave it, you may eat all the meat you desire.

pob.text: And you shall offer your burnt offerings[a], the flesh and the blood, on the altar of Yahweh your God; and the blood of your sacrifices shall be poured out on the altar of Yahweh your God, and you shall eat the flesh.

public_domain_references.bsb: and you shall rejoice before the LORD your God in the place He will choose as a dwelling for His Name—you, your sons and daughters, your menservants and maidservants, and the Levite within your gates, as well as the foreigner, the fatherless, and the widows among you.
public_domain_references.web: You shall rejoice before Yahweh your God: you, your son, your daughter, your male servant, your female servant, the Levite who is within your gates, the foreigner, the fatherless, and the widow who are among you, in the place which Yahweh your God shall choose to cause his name to dwell there.
public_domain_references.asv: and thou shalt rejoice before Jehovah thy God, thou, and thy son, and thy daughter, and thy man-servant, and thy maid-servant, and the Levite that is within thy gates, and the sojourner, and the fatherless, and the widow, that are in the midst of thee, in the place which Jehovah thy God shall choose, to cause his name to dwell there.
public_domain_references.kjv: And thou shalt rejoice before the LORD thy God, thou, and thy son, and thy daughter, and thy manservant, and thy maidservant, and the Levite that [is] within thy gates, and the stranger, and the fatherless, and the widow, that [are] among you, in the place which the LORD thy God hath chosen to place his name there.
public_domain_references.brenton: And thou shalt rejoice before the Lord thy God, thou and thy son, and thy daughter, thy man-servant and thy maid-servant, and the Levite, and the stranger, and the orphan, and the widow which dwells among you, in whatsoever place the Lord thy God shall choose, that his name should be called there.

pob.text: Remember that you were a slave in Egypt[a], and keep and do these statutes.

spob.text: Remember that you were a slave in Egypt.[a] Be careful to follow these laws and put them into practice.

public_domain_references.bsb: Remember that you were slaves in Egypt, and carefully follow these statutes.
public_domain_references.web: You shall remember that you were a slave in Egypt. You shall observe and do these statutes.
public_domain_references.asv: And thou shalt remember that thou wast a bondman in Egypt: and thou shalt observe and do these statutes.
public_domain_references.kjv: And thou shalt remember that thou wast a bondman in Egypt: and thou shalt observe and do these statutes.
public_domain_references.brenton: And thou shalt remember that thou wast a servant in the land of Egypt, and thou shalt observe and do these commands.

pob.text: You shall keep the Feast of Booths for seven days[a], when you gather in from your threshing floor and from your winepress.

spob.text: You must celebrate the Feast of Booths[a] for seven days. Hold it when you gather in the grain from your threshing floor and the wine from your winepress.

public_domain_references.bsb: You are to celebrate the Feast of Tabernacles for seven days after you have gathered the produce of your threshing floor and your winepress.
public_domain_references.web: You shall keep the feast of booths seven days, after you have gathered in from your threshing floor and from your wine press.
public_domain_references.asv: Thou shalt keep the feast of tabernacles seven days, after that thou hast gathered in from thy threshing-floor and from thy winepress:
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ Thou shalt observe the feast of tabernacles seven days, after that thou hast gathered in thy corn and thy wine:
public_domain_references.brenton: Thou shalt keep for thyself the feast of tabernacles seven days, when thou gatherest in [thy produce] from thy corn-floor and thy wine-press.

pob.text: And you shall rejoice in your festival—you and your son and your daughter[a], and your male slave and your female slave, and the Levite, and the sojourner, and the fatherless, and the widow[d][c][b], who are within your gates.

spob.text: Celebrate your festival with joy, together with your sons and daughters, your male and female slaves, and these people who live in your towns: the Levites, non-Israelite residents, fatherless people, and widows.

public_domain_references.bsb: And you shall rejoice in your feast—you, your sons and daughters, your menservants and maidservants, and the Levite, as well as the foreigner, the fatherless, and the widows among you.
public_domain_references.web: You shall rejoice in your feast, you, your son, your daughter, your male servant, your female servant, the Levite, the foreigner, the fatherless, and the widow who are within your gates.
public_domain_references.asv: and thou shalt rejoice in thy feast, thou, and thy son, and thy daughter, and thy man-servant, and thy maid-servant, and the Levite, and the sojourner, and the fatherless, and the widow, that are within thy gates.
public_domain_references.kjv: And thou shalt rejoice in thy feast, thou, and thy son, and thy daughter, and thy manservant, and thy maidservant, and the Levite, the stranger, and the fatherless, and the widow, that [are] within thy gates.
public_domain_references.brenton: And thou shalt rejoice in thy feast, thou, and thy son, and thy daughter, thy man-servant, and thy maid-servant, and the Levite, and the stranger, and the orphan, and the widow that is in thy cities.

pob.text: For seven days you shall celebrate a feast to Yahweh your God in the place that Yahweh will choose[a], because Yahweh your God will bless you in all your produce and in all the work of your hands, and you shall be altogether joyful.

spob.text: For seven days, hold a festival in honor of Yahweh your God at the place Yahweh will choose. Do this because Yahweh your God will bless you in all your produce and in all the work of your hands. As a result, you will be full of joy.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: For seven days you shall celebrate a feast to the LORD your God in the place He will choose, because the LORD your God will bless you in all your produce and in all the work of your hands, so that your joy will be complete.
public_domain_references.web: You shall keep a feast to Yahweh your God seven days in the place which Yahweh chooses, because Yahweh your God will bless you in all your increase and in all the work of your hands, and you shall be altogether joyful.
public_domain_references.asv: Seven days shalt thou keep a feast unto Jehovah thy God in the place which Jehovah shall choose; because Jehovah thy God will bless thee in all thine increase, and in all the work of thy hands, and thou shalt be altogether joyful.
public_domain_references.kjv: Seven days shalt thou keep a solemn feast unto the LORD thy God in the place which the LORD shall choose: because the LORD thy God shall bless thee in all thine increase, and in all the works of thine hands, therefore thou shalt surely rejoice.
public_domain_references.brenton: Seven days shalt thou keep a feast to the Lord thy God in the place which the Lord thy God shall choose for himself; and if the Lord thy God shall bless thee in all thy fruits, and in every work of thy hands, then thou shalt rejoice.

pob.text: Three times a year all your males shall appear before Yahweh your God in the place that he will choose: at the Feast of Unleavened Bread[a], at the Feast of Weeks, and at the Feast of Booths[c][b]. No one shall appear before Yahweh empty-handed.

spob.text: Three times each year, every male among you must come before Yahweh your God at the place he will choose. They must come for the Feast of Unleavened Bread, the Feast of Weeks, and the Feast of Booths.[a] No one may come before Yahweh empty-handed; each must bring the required gift.

public_domain_references.bsb: Three times a year all your men are to appear before the LORD your God in the place He will choose: at the Feast of Unleavened Bread, the Feast of Weeks, and the Feast of Tabernacles. No one should appear before the LORD empty-handed.
public_domain_references.web: Three times in a year all of your males shall appear before Yahweh your God in the place which he chooses: in the feast of unleavened bread, in the feast of weeks, and in the feast of booths. They shall not appear before Yahweh empty.
public_domain_references.asv: Three times in a year shall all thy males appear before Jehovah thy God in the place which he shall choose: in the feast of unleavened bread, and in the feast of weeks, and in the feast of tabernacles; and they shall not appear before Jehovah empty:
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ Three times in a year shall all thy males appear before the LORD thy God in the place which he shall choose; in the feast of unleavened bread, and in the feast of weeks, and in the feast of tabernacles: and they shall not appear before the LORD empty:
public_domain_references.brenton: Three times in the year shall all thy males appear before the Lord thy God in the place which the Lord shall choose in the feast of unleavened bread, and in the feast of weeks, and in the feast of tabernacles: thou shalt not appear before the Lord thy God empty.

pob.text: Each man shall give according to the gift of his hand[a], according to the blessing of Yahweh your God that he has given you.

spob.text: Each man must give what he is able to give, in proportion to the blessing Yahweh your God has given you.

public_domain_references.bsb: Everyone must appear with a gift as he is able, according to the blessing the LORD your God has given you.
public_domain_references.web: Every man shall give as he is able, according to Yahweh your God’s blessing which he has given you.
public_domain_references.asv: every man shall give as he is able, according to the blessing of Jehovah thy God which he hath given thee.
public_domain_references.kjv: Every man [shall give] as he is able, according to the blessing of the LORD thy God which he hath given thee.
public_domain_references.brenton: Each one according to his ability, according to the blessing of the Lord thy God which he has given thee.

pob.text: You shall appoint judges and officers for yourself in all your gates that Yahweh your God is giving you[a], according to your tribes[b], and they shall judge the people with righteous judgment.

spob.text: Appoint judges and officers throughout your tribes, at the gates of every town Yahweh your God is giving you.[a] They must judge the people justly.

public_domain_references.bsb: You are to appoint judges and officials for your tribes in every town that the LORD your God is giving you. They are to judge the people with righteous judgment.
public_domain_references.web: You shall make judges and officers in all your gates, which Yahweh your God gives you, according to your tribes; and they shall judge the people with righteous judgment.
public_domain_references.asv: Judges and officers shalt thou make thee in all thy gates, which Jehovah thy God giveth thee, according to thy tribes; and they shall judge the people with righteous judgment.
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ Judges and officers shalt thou make thee in all thy gates, which the LORD thy God giveth thee, throughout thy tribes: and they shall judge the people with just judgment.
public_domain_references.brenton: Thou shalt make for thyself judges and officers in thy cities, which the Lord thy God gives thee in [thy] tribes, and they shall judge the people with righteous judgment:

pob.text: You shall not pervert justice[a]; you shall not show partiality; and you shall not take a bribe[b], for the bribe blinds the eyes of the wise and twists the words of the righteous.

spob.text: Do not make an unjust ruling. Do not favor one person over another, and do not accept a bribe. A bribe blinds the eyes of wise people and twists the words of those who are in the right.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: Do not deny justice or show partiality. Do not accept a bribe, for a bribe blinds the eyes of the wise and twists the words of the righteous.
public_domain_references.web: You shall not pervert justice. You shall not show partiality. You shall not take a bribe, for a bribe blinds the eyes of the wise and perverts the words of the righteous.
public_domain_references.asv: Thou shalt not wrest justice: thou shalt not respect persons; neither shalt thou take a bribe; for a bribe doth blind the eyes of the wise, and pervert the words of the righteous.
public_domain_references.kjv: Thou shalt not wrest judgment; thou shalt not respect persons, neither take a gift: for a gift doth blind the eyes of the wise, and pervert the words of the righteous.
public_domain_references.brenton: they shall not wrest judgment, nor favour persons, nor receive a gift; for gifts blind the eyes of the wise, and pervert the words of the righteous.

pob.text: Justice[a], justice you shall pursue[b], so that you may live and possess the land that Yahweh your God is giving you.

spob.text: You must pursue justice—yes, justice—so that you may live and take possession[b] of the land Yahweh your God is giving you.

public_domain_references.bsb: Pursue justice, and justice alone, so that you may live, and you may possess the land that the LORD your God is giving you.
public_domain_references.web: You shall follow that which is altogether just, that you may live and inherit the land which Yahweh your God gives you.
public_domain_references.asv: That which is altogether just shalt thou follow, that thou mayest live, and inherit the land which Jehovah thy God giveth thee.
public_domain_references.kjv: That which is altogether just shalt thou follow, that thou mayest live, and inherit the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee.
public_domain_references.brenton: Thou shalt justly pursue justice, that ye may live, and go in and inherit the land which the Lord thy God gives thee.

pob.text: You shall not plant for yourself an Asherah of any kind of tree beside the altar of Yahweh your God that you make for yourself[a].

spob.text: Do not plant for yourself any kind of tree as an Asherah beside the altar of Yahweh your God that you make for yourself.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: Do not set up any wooden Asherah pole next to the altar you will build for the LORD your God,
public_domain_references.web: You shall not plant for yourselves an Asherah of any kind of tree beside Yahweh your God’s altar, which you shall make for yourselves.
public_domain_references.asv: Thou shalt not plant thee an Asherah of any kind of tree beside the altar of Jehovah thy God, which thou shalt make thee.
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ Thou shalt not plant thee a grove of any trees near unto the altar of the LORD thy God, which thou shalt make thee.
public_domain_references.brenton: Thou shalt not plant for thyself a grove; thou shalt not plant for thyself any tree near the altar of thy God.

pob.text: And you shall not set up for yourself a pillar[a], which Yahweh your God hates.

spob.text: Do not set up for yourself a sacred stone pillar for worship. Yahweh your God hates such pillars.

public_domain_references.bsb: and do not set up for yourselves a sacred pillar, which the LORD your God hates.
public_domain_references.web: Neither shall you set yourself up a sacred stone which Yahweh your God hates.
public_domain_references.asv: Neither shalt thou set thee up a pillar; which Jehovah thy God hateth.
public_domain_references.kjv: Neither shalt thou set thee up [any] image; which the LORD thy God hateth.
public_domain_references.brenton: Thou shalt not set up for thyself a pillar, which the Lord thy God hates.

pob.text: You shall not sacrifice to Yahweh your God an ox or a sheep that has in it a blemish[a], any bad thing, for that is an abomination to Yahweh your God.

spob.text: Do not sacrifice to Yahweh your God an ox or a sheep[a] that has any blemish or other defect. Such an offering is an abomination—something Yahweh your God detests.

public_domain_references.bsb: You shall not sacrifice to the LORD your God an ox or a sheep with any defect or serious flaw, for that is detestable to the LORD your God.
public_domain_references.web: You shall not sacrifice to Yahweh your God an ox or a sheep in which is a defect or anything evil; for that is an abomination to Yahweh your God.
public_domain_references.asv: Thou shalt not sacrifice unto Jehovah thy God an ox, or a sheep, wherein is a blemish, [or] anything evil; for that is an abomination unto Jehovah thy God.
public_domain_references.kjv: Thou shalt not sacrifice unto the LORD thy God [any] bullock, or sheep, wherein is blemish, [or] any evilfavouredness: for that [is] an abomination unto the LORD thy God.
public_domain_references.brenton: Thou shalt not sacrifice to the Lord thy God a calf or a sheep, in which there is a blemish, [or] any evil thing; for it is an abomination to the Lord thy God.

pob.text: If there is found among you[a], within one of your gates that Yahweh your God is giving you, a man or a woman who does what is evil in the eyes of Yahweh your God by transgressing his covenant[b],

spob.text: If a man or a woman is found among you in one of the towns[a] Yahweh your God is giving you, and does what is evil in the eyes of Yahweh your God by violating his covenant,

public_domain_references.bsb: If a man or woman among you in one of the towns that the LORD your God gives you is found doing evil in the sight of the LORD your God by transgressing His covenant
public_domain_references.web: If there is found among you, within any of your gates which Yahweh your God gives you, a man or woman who does that which is evil in Yahweh your God’s sight in transgressing his covenant,
public_domain_references.asv: If there be found in the midst of thee, within any of thy gates which Jehovah thy God giveth thee, man or woman, that doeth that which is evil in the sight of Jehovah thy God, in transgressing his covenant,
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ If there be found among you, within any of thy gates which the LORD thy God giveth thee, man or woman, that hath wrought wickedness in the sight of the LORD thy God, in transgressing his covenant,
public_domain_references.brenton: And if there should be found in any one of thy cities, which the Lord thy God gives thee, a man or a woman who shall do that which is evil before the Lord thy God, so as to transgress his covenant,

pob.text: and goes and serves other gods and bows down to them[a], or to the sun or to the moon or to all the host of heaven, which I have not commanded[b],

spob.text: and goes and serves other gods, bowing down to them or to the sun, the moon, or the whole array of heaven[a]—which I have not commanded.[b]

public_domain_references.bsb: and going to worship other gods, bowing down to them or to the sun or moon or any of the host of heaven—which I have forbidden—

public_domain_references.asv: and hath gone and served other gods, and worshipped them, or the sun, or the moon, or any of the host of heaven, which I have not commanded,
public_domain_references.kjv: And hath gone and served other gods, and worshipped them, either the sun, or moon, or any of the host of heaven, which I have not commanded;
public_domain_references.brenton: and they should go and serve other gods, and worship them, the sun, or the moon, or any of the host of heaven, which he commanded thee not to do,

pob.text: and it is reported to you[a], and you hear of it, and you investigate thoroughly, and behold, it is true and certain that this abomination has been done in Israel,

spob.text: When this is reported to you and you hear about it, investigate it carefully. If you find that it is true and certain that this abomination has been committed in Israel,

public_domain_references.web: and you are told, and you have heard of it, then you shall inquire diligently. Behold, if it is true, and the thing certain, that such abomination is done in Israel,
public_domain_references.asv: and it be told thee, and thou hast heard of it; then shalt thou inquire diligently; and, behold, if it be true, and the thing certain, that such abomination is wrought in Israel,
public_domain_references.kjv: And it be told thee, and thou hast heard [of it], and enquired diligently, and, behold, [it be] true, [and] the thing certain, [that] such abomination is wrought in Israel:
public_domain_references.brenton: and it be told thee, and thou shalt have enquired diligently, and, behold, the thing really took place, this abomination has been done in Israel;

pob.text: then you shall bring out to your gates that man or that woman who did this evil thing[a], that man or that woman, and you shall stone them with stones[b], and they shall die.

spob.text: Then take that man or woman who did this evil thing[b] out to your town gates.[a] Throw stones at that man or woman, and they will die.

public_domain_references.bsb: you must bring out to your gates the man or woman who has done this evil thing, and you must stone that person to death.

public_domain_references.kjv: Then shalt thou bring forth that man or that woman, which have committed that wicked thing, unto thy gates, [even] that man or that woman, and shalt stone them with stones, till they die.
public_domain_references.brenton: then shalt thou bring out that man, or that woman, and ye shall stone them with stones, and they shall die.

pob.text: On the testimony of two witnesses or three witnesses[a], the one to die shall be put to death[b]; he shall not be put to death on the testimony of one witness.

spob.text: A person liable to execution must be put to death only on the testimony of two or three witnesses. No one must be put to death on the testimony of a single witness.

public_domain_references.bsb: On the testimony of two or three witnesses a man shall be put to death, but he shall not be executed on the testimony of a lone witness.
public_domain_references.web: At the mouth of two witnesses, or three witnesses, he who is to die shall be put to death. At the mouth of one witness he shall not be put to death.
public_domain_references.asv: At the mouth of two witnesses, or three witnesses, shall he that is to die be put to death; at the mouth of one witness he shall not be put to death.
public_domain_references.kjv: At the mouth of two witnesses, or three witnesses, shall he that is worthy of death be put to death; [but] at the mouth of one witness he shall not be put to death.
public_domain_references.brenton: He shall die on the testimony of two or three witnesses; a man who is put to death shall not be put to death for one witness.

pob.text: The hand of the witnesses shall be first against him to put him to death[a], and afterward the hand of all the people[b]. So you shall purge the evil from your midst.

spob.text: The witnesses must be the first to put him to death. After that, all the people must take part in putting him to death.[a] In this way, you must remove the evil from your community.

public_domain_references.bsb: The hands of the witnesses shall be the first in putting him to death, and after that, the hands of all the people. So you must purge the evil from among you.
public_domain_references.web: The hands of the witnesses shall be first on him to put him to death, and afterward the hands of all the people. So you shall remove the evil from among you.
public_domain_references.asv: The hand of the witnesses shall be first upon him to put him to death, and afterward the hand of all the people. So thou shalt put away the evil from the midst of thee.
public_domain_references.kjv: The hands of the witnesses shall be first upon him to put him to death, and afterward the hands of all the people. So thou shalt put the evil away from among you.
public_domain_references.brenton: And the hand of the witnesses shall be upon him among the first to put him to death, and the hand of the people at the last; so shalt thou remove the evil one from among yourselves.

pob.text: If a matter for judgment is too difficult for you—between bloodshed and bloodshed[a], between one legal claim and another, and between one injury and another[d][c][b], matters of dispute within your gates—then you shall arise and go up to the place that Yahweh your God will choose.

spob.text: If a disputed case in your town court is too difficult for you to decide—whether it concerns one case of bloodshed or another, one legal claim or another, or one kind of injury or another[a]—you must set out and go up to the place Yahweh your God will choose.

public_domain_references.bsb: If a case is too difficult for you to judge, whether the controversy within your gates is regarding bloodshed, lawsuits, or assaults, you must go up to the place the LORD your God will choose.
public_domain_references.web: If there arises a matter too hard for you in judgment, between blood and blood, between plea and plea, and between stroke and stroke, being matters of controversy within your gates, then you shall arise, and go up to the place which Yahweh your God chooses.
public_domain_references.asv: If there arise a matter too hard for thee in judgment, between blood and blood, between plea and plea, and between stroke and stroke, being matters of controversy within thy gates; then shalt thou arise, and get thee up unto the place which Jehovah thy God shall choose;
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ If there arise a matter too hard for thee in judgment, between blood and blood, between plea and plea, and between stroke and stroke, [being] matters of controversy within thy gates: then shalt thou arise, and get thee up into the place which the LORD thy God shall choose;
public_domain_references.brenton: And if a matter shall be too hard for thee in judgment, between blood and blood, and between cause and cause, and between stroke and stroke, and between contradiction and contradiction, matters of judgment in your cities;

pob.text: And you shall come to the Levitical priests and to the judge who is in office in those days[a], and you shall inquire, and they shall declare to you the decision in the case.

spob.text: Go to the Levitical priests and to the judge serving at that time. Ask them for a ruling, and they will announce the decision in the case.

public_domain_references.bsb: You are to go to the Levitical priests and to the judge who presides at that time. Inquire of them, and they will give you a verdict in the case.
public_domain_references.web: You shall come to the priests who are Levites and to the judge who shall be in those days. You shall inquire, and they shall give you the verdict.
public_domain_references.asv: and thou shalt come unto the priests the Levites, and unto the judge that shall be in those days: and thou shalt inquire; and they shall show thee the sentence of judgment.
public_domain_references.kjv: And thou shalt come unto the priests the Levites, and unto the judge that shall be in those days, and enquire; and they shall shew thee the sentence of judgment:
public_domain_references.brenton: then thou shalt arise and go up to the place which the Lord thy God shall choose, and thou shalt come to the priests the Levites, and to the judge who shall be in those days, and they shall search out [the matter] and report the judgment to thee.

pob.text: You shall act according to the word that they declare to you from that place which Yahweh will choose[a], and you shall be careful to do according to all that they instruct you.

spob.text: You must follow the ruling[a] they give you from the place Yahweh will choose. Be careful to do everything they instruct you to do.

public_domain_references.bsb: You must abide by the verdict they give you at the place the LORD will choose. Be careful to do everything they instruct you,
public_domain_references.web: You shall do according to the decisions of the verdict which they shall give you from that place which Yahweh chooses. You shall observe to do according to all that they shall teach you.
public_domain_references.asv: And thou shalt do according to the tenor of the sentence which they shall show thee from that place which Jehovah shall choose; and thou shalt observe to do according to all that they shall teach thee:
public_domain_references.kjv: And thou shalt do according to the sentence, which they of that place which the LORD shall choose shall shew thee; and thou shalt observe to do according to all that they inform thee:
public_domain_references.brenton: And thou shalt act according to the thing which they shall report to thee out of the place which the Lord thy God shall choose, and thou shalt observe to do all whatsoever shall have been by law appointed to thee.

pob.text: According to the instruction that they give you[a], and according to the judgment that they tell you, you shall do; you shall not turn aside from the word that they declare to you[b], to the right or to the left.

spob.text: You must follow the instruction they give you and carry out the judgment they announce. Do not turn aside from the ruling they declare to you, either to the right or to the left.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: according to the terms of law they give and the verdict they proclaim. Do not turn aside to the right or to the left from the decision they declare to you.
