public_domain_references.bsb: Then all the peoples of the earth will see that you are called by the name of the LORD, and they will stand in awe of you.
public_domain_references.web: All the peoples of the earth shall see that you are called by Yahweh’s name, and they will be afraid of you.
public_domain_references.asv: And all the peoples of the earth shall see that thou art called by the name of Jehovah; and they shall be afraid of thee.
public_domain_references.kjv: And all people of the earth shall see that thou art called by the name of the LORD; and they shall be afraid of thee.
public_domain_references.brenton: And all the nations of the earth shall see thee, that the name of the Lord is called upon thee, and they shall stand in awe of thee.

pob.text: And Yahweh will make you abound in prosperity[a], in the fruit of your womb, in the fruit of your livestock, and in the fruit of your ground[c][b], on the land that Yahweh swore to your fathers to give you.

spob.text: Yahweh will make you very prosperous. He will give you an abundance of the fruit of your womb, the fruit of your livestock, and the fruit of your soil[a], in the land he swore to your ancestors that he would give you.

public_domain_references.bsb: The LORD will make you prosper abundantly—in the fruit of your womb, the offspring of your livestock, and the produce of your land—in the land that the LORD swore to your fathers to give you.
public_domain_references.web: Yahweh will grant you abundant prosperity in the fruit of your body, in the fruit of your livestock, and in the fruit of your ground, in the land which Yahweh swore to your fathers to give you.
public_domain_references.asv: And Jehovah will make thee plenteous for good, in the fruit of thy body, and in the fruit of thy cattle, and in the fruit of thy ground, in the land which Jehovah sware unto thy fathers to give thee.
public_domain_references.kjv: And the LORD shall make thee plenteous in goods, in the fruit of thy body, and in the fruit of thy cattle, and in the fruit of thy ground, in the land which the LORD sware unto thy fathers to give thee.
public_domain_references.brenton: And the Lord thy God shall multiply thee for good in the offspring of thy body, and in the offspring of thy cattle, and in the fruits of thy land, on thy land which the Lord sware to thy fathers to give to thee.

pob.text: Yahweh will open to you his good storehouse[a], the heavens, to give the rain of your land in its season and to bless all the work of your hand. You will lend to many nations, but you will not borrow.

spob.text: Yahweh will open his good storehouse for you—the heavens. He will send rain on your land at the right time and bless all your work. You will lend to many nations, but you will not borrow.

public_domain_references.bsb: The LORD will open the heavens, His abundant storehouse, to send rain on your land in season and to bless all the work of your hands. You will lend to many nations, but borrow from none.
public_domain_references.web: Yahweh will open to you his good treasure in the sky, to give the rain of your land in its season, and to bless all the work of your hand. You will lend to many nations, and you will not borrow.
public_domain_references.asv: Jehovah will open unto thee his good treasure the heavens, to give the rain of thy land in its season, and to bless all the work of thy hand: and thou shalt lend unto many nations, and thou shalt not borrow.
public_domain_references.kjv: The LORD shall open unto thee his good treasure, the heaven to give the rain unto thy land in his season, and to bless all the work of thine hand: and thou shalt lend unto many nations, and thou shalt not borrow.
public_domain_references.brenton: May the Lord open to thee his good treasure, the heaven, to give rain to thy land in season: may he bless all the works of thy hands: so shalt thou lend to many nations, but thou shalt not borrow; and thou shalt rule over many nations, but they shall not rule over thee.

pob.text: And Yahweh will make you the head and not the tail[a], and you will be only above, and you will not be beneath, if you listen to the commandments of Yahweh your God that I am commanding you today, to keep and to do them.

spob.text: Yahweh will make you the head, not the tail. You will be above, never beneath, if you listen to[a] the commandments of Yahweh your God that I am commanding you today, keep them, and carry them out.

public_domain_references.bsb: The LORD will make you the head and not the tail; you will only move upward and never downward, if you hear and carefully follow the commandments of the LORD your God, which I am giving you today.
public_domain_references.web: Yahweh will make you the head, and not the tail. You will be above only, and you will not be beneath, if you listen to the commandments of Yahweh your God which I command you today, to observe and to do,
public_domain_references.asv: And Jehovah will make thee the head, and not the tail; and thou shalt be above only, and thou shalt not be beneath; if thou shalt hearken unto the commandments of Jehovah thy God, which I command thee this day, to observe and to do [them],
public_domain_references.kjv: And the LORD shall make thee the head, and not the tail; and thou shalt be above only, and thou shalt not be beneath; if that thou hearken unto the commandments of the LORD thy God, which I command thee this day, to observe and to do [them:]
public_domain_references.brenton: The Lord thy God make thee the head, and not the tail; and thou shalt then be above and thou shalt not be below, if thou wilt hearken to the voice of the Lord thy God, in all things that I charge thee this day to observe.

pob.text: And do not turn aside from any of the words that I am commanding you today[a], to the right or to the left[b], to go after other gods to serve them.

spob.text: Do not turn away from anything I am commanding you today. Do not stray to the right or the left, going after other gods and serving them.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: Do not turn aside to the right or to the left from any of the words I command you today, and do not go after other gods to serve them.
public_domain_references.web: and shall not turn away from any of the words which I command you today, to the right hand or to the left, to go after other gods to serve them.
public_domain_references.asv: and shalt not turn aside from any of the words which I command you this day, to the right hand, or to the left, to go after other gods to serve them.
public_domain_references.kjv: And thou shalt not go aside from any of the words which I command thee this day, [to] the right hand, or [to] the left, to go after other gods to serve them.
public_domain_references.brenton: Thou shalt not turn aside from any of the commandments, which I charge thee this day, to the right hand or to the left, to go after other gods to serve them.

pob.text: But if you do not listen to the voice of Yahweh your God[a], to keep and to do all his commandments and his statutes that I am commanding you today[b], then all these curses will come upon you and overtake you.

spob.text: But if you do not listen to Yahweh your God[a] by following all his commandments and laws[b] that I am commanding you today, then all these curses will come upon you and overtake you.

public_domain_references.bsb: If, however, you do not obey the LORD your God by carefully following all His commandments and statutes I am giving you today, all these curses will come upon you and overtake you:
public_domain_references.web: But it shall come to pass, if you will not listen to Yahweh your God’s voice, to observe to do all his commandments and his statutes which I command you today, that all these curses will come on you and overtake you.
public_domain_references.asv: But it shall come to pass, if thou wilt not hearken unto the voice of Jehovah thy God, to observe to do all his commandments and his statutes which I command thee this day, that all these curses shall come upon thee, and overtake thee.
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ But it shall come to pass, if thou wilt not hearken unto the voice of the LORD thy God, to observe to do all his commandments and his statutes which I command thee this day; that all these curses shall come upon thee, and overtake thee:
public_domain_references.brenton: But it shall come to pass, if thou wilt not hearken to the voice of the Lord thy God, to observe all his commandments, as many as I charge thee this day, then all these curses shall come on thee, and overtake thee.

pob.text: Cursed are you in the city[a], and cursed are you in the field.

spob.text: You are cursed in the city, and you are cursed in the field.

public_domain_references.bsb: You will be cursed in the city and cursed in the country.
public_domain_references.web: You will be cursed in the city, and you will be cursed in the field.
public_domain_references.asv: Cursed shalt thou be in the city, and cursed shalt thou be in the field.
public_domain_references.kjv: Cursed [shalt] thou [be] in the city, and cursed [shalt] thou [be] in the field.
public_domain_references.brenton: Cursed [shalt] thou [be] in the city, and cursed shalt thou be in the field.

pob.text: Cursed shall be your basket and your kneading bowl[a].

spob.text: Your basket and your bowl for kneading dough will be cursed.

public_domain_references.bsb: Your basket and kneading bowl will be cursed.
public_domain_references.web: Your basket and your kneading trough will be cursed.
public_domain_references.asv: Cursed shall be thy basket and thy kneading-trough.
public_domain_references.kjv: Cursed [shall be] thy basket and thy store.
public_domain_references.brenton: Cursed shall be thy barns and thy stores.

pob.text: Cursed shall be the fruit of your womb[a], and the fruit of your ground[b], the offspring of your herds and the young of your flocks.

spob.text: The fruit of your womb—your children—and the fruit of your ground—your crops—will be cursed. So will the calves of your herds and the young of your flocks.

public_domain_references.bsb: The fruit of your womb will be cursed, as well as the produce of your land, the calves of your herds, and the lambs of your flocks.
public_domain_references.web: The fruit of your body, the fruit of your ground, the increase of your livestock, and the young of your flock will be cursed.
public_domain_references.asv: Cursed shall be the fruit of thy body, and the fruit of thy ground, the increase of thy cattle, and the young of thy flock.
public_domain_references.kjv: Cursed [shall be] the fruit of thy body, and the fruit of thy land, the increase of thy kine, and the flocks of thy sheep.
public_domain_references.brenton: Cursed shall be the offspring of thy body, and the fruits of thy land, the herds of thine oxen, and the flocks of thy sheep.

pob.text: Cursed shall you be when you come in[a], and cursed shall you be when you go out.

spob.text: You will be cursed when you come in, and you will be cursed when you go out—in every part of daily life.

public_domain_references.bsb: You will be cursed when you come in and cursed when you go out.
public_domain_references.web: You will be cursed when you come in, and you will be cursed when you go out.
public_domain_references.asv: Cursed shalt thou be when thou comest in, and cursed shalt thou be when thou goest out.
public_domain_references.kjv: Cursed [shalt] thou [be] when thou comest in, and cursed [shalt] thou [be] when thou goest out.
public_domain_references.brenton: Cursed shalt thou be in thy coming in, and cursed shalt thou be in thy going out.

pob.text: Yahweh will send on you the curse[a], the confusion, and the rebuke in every undertaking of your hand that you do, until you are destroyed and until you perish quickly, because of the evil of your deeds by which you have forsaken me.

spob.text: Yahweh will send a curse, confusion, and rebuke upon you in everything you set your hand to do. This will continue until you are destroyed—until you quickly perish—because of the evil deeds by which you have forsaken me.

public_domain_references.bsb: The LORD will send curses upon you, confusion and reproof in all to which you put your hand, until you are destroyed and quickly perish because of the wickedness you have committed in forsaking Him.
public_domain_references.web: Yahweh will send on you cursing, confusion, and rebuke in all that you put your hand to do, until you are destroyed and until you perish quickly, because of the evil of your doings, by which you have forsaken me.
public_domain_references.asv: Jehovah will send upon thee cursing, discomfiture, and rebuke, in all that thou puttest thy hand unto to do, until thou be destroyed, and until thou perish quickly; because of the evil of thy doings, whereby thou hast forsaken me.
public_domain_references.kjv: The LORD shall send upon thee cursing, vexation, and rebuke, in all that thou settest thine hand unto for to do, until thou be destroyed, and until thou perish quickly; because of the wickedness of thy doings, whereby thou hast forsaken me.
public_domain_references.brenton: The Lord send upon thee want, and famine, and consumption on all things on which thou shalt put thy hand, until he shall have utterly destroyed thee, and until he shall have consumed thee quickly because of thine evil devices, because thou hast forsaken me.

pob.text: Yahweh will make the plague cling to you until he has wiped you out from the land that you are entering to possess[a][b].

spob.text: Yahweh will bring a plague[a] on you that will not go away until he has wiped you out[b] from the land you are about to enter and take as your own.

public_domain_references.bsb: The LORD will make the plague cling to you until He has exterminated you from the land that you are entering to possess.
public_domain_references.web: Yahweh will make the pestilence cling to you, until he has consumed you from off the land where you go in to possess it.
public_domain_references.asv: Jehovah will make the pestilence cleave unto thee, until he have consumed thee from off the land, whither thou goest in to possess it.
public_domain_references.kjv: The LORD shall make the pestilence cleave unto thee, until he have consumed thee from off the land, whither thou goest to possess it.
public_domain_references.brenton: The Lord cause the pestilence to cleave to thee, until he shall have consumed thee off the land into which thou goest to inherit it.

pob.text: Yahweh will strike you with wasting disease[a], with fever, with inflammation, with burning heat, with the sword, with blight, and with mildew[b]; and they will pursue you until you perish.

spob.text: Yahweh will strike you with a disease that wastes your body, fever, inflammation, burning heat, the sword, crop blight, and mildew. All these disasters will pursue you until you perish.

public_domain_references.bsb: The LORD will strike you with wasting disease, with fever and inflammation, with scorching heat and drought, and with blight and mildew; these will pursue you until you perish.
public_domain_references.web: Yahweh will strike you with consumption, with fever, with inflammation, with fiery heat, with the sword, with blight, and with mildew. They will pursue you until you perish.
public_domain_references.asv: Jehovah will smite thee with consumption, and with fever, and with inflammation, and with fiery heat, and with the sword, and with blasting, and with mildew; and they shall pursue thee until thou perish.
public_domain_references.kjv: The LORD shall smite thee with a consumption, and with a fever, and with an inflammation, and with an extreme burning, and with the sword, and with blasting, and with mildew; and they shall pursue thee until thou perish.
public_domain_references.brenton: The Lord smite thee with distress, and fever, and cold, and inflammation, and blighting, and paleness, and they shall pursue thee until they have destroyed thee.

pob.text: And the heavens above your head shall be bronze[a], and the earth beneath you iron.

spob.text: Overhead, the heavens will be bronze.[a] Under you, the earth will be iron.

public_domain_references.bsb: The sky over your head will be bronze, and the earth beneath you iron.
public_domain_references.web: Your sky that is over your head will be bronze, and the earth that is under you will be iron.
public_domain_references.asv: And thy heaven that is over thy head shall be brass, and the earth that is under thee shall be iron.
public_domain_references.kjv: And thy heaven that [is] over thy head shall be brass, and the earth that is under thee [shall be] iron.
public_domain_references.brenton: And thou shalt have over thine head a sky of brass, and the earth under thee shall be iron.

pob.text: Yahweh will make the rain of your land dust and powder[a]; from the heavens it will come down on you until you are destroyed.

spob.text: Yahweh will turn the rain for your land into dust and powder. It will fall from the heavens on you until you are destroyed.

public_domain_references.bsb: The LORD will turn the rain of your land into dust and powder; it will descend on you from the sky until you are destroyed.
public_domain_references.web: Yahweh will make the rain of your land powder and dust. It will come down on you from the sky, until you are destroyed.
public_domain_references.asv: Jehovah will make the rain of thy land powder and dust: from heaven shall it come down upon thee, until thou be destroyed.
public_domain_references.kjv: The LORD shall make the rain of thy land powder and dust: from heaven shall it come down upon thee, until thou be destroyed.
public_domain_references.brenton: The Lord thy God make the rain of thy land dust; and dust shall come down from heaven, until it shall have destroyed thee, and until it shall have quickly consumed thee.

pob.text: Yahweh will give you over as defeated before your enemies. You will go out against them by one way[a], and by seven ways you will flee before them, and you will become a horror to all the kingdoms of the earth.

spob.text: Yahweh will hand you over to your enemies, and they will defeat you. You will march out against them on one road, but you will flee from them on seven roads. You will become an object of horror[a] to every kingdom on earth.

public_domain_references.bsb: The LORD will cause you to be defeated before your enemies. You will march out against them in one direction but flee from them in seven. You will be an object of horror to all the kingdoms of the earth.
public_domain_references.web: Yahweh will cause you to be struck before your enemies. You will go out one way against them, and will flee seven ways before them. You will be tossed back and forth among all the kingdoms of the earth.
public_domain_references.asv: Jehovah will cause thee to be smitten before thine enemies; thou shalt go out one way against them, and shalt flee seven ways before them: and thou shalt be tossed to and from among all the kingdoms of the earth.
public_domain_references.kjv: The LORD shall cause thee to be smitten before thine enemies: thou shalt go out one way against them, and flee seven ways before them: and shalt be removed into all the kingdoms of the earth.
public_domain_references.brenton: The Lord give thee up for slaughter before thine enemies: thou shalt go out against them one way, and flee from their face seven ways; and thou shalt be a dispersion in all the kingdoms of the earth.

pob.text: Your carcass will become food for every bird of the sky and for the beasts of the earth[c][b][a], and there will be no one to frighten them away.

spob.text: Every bird of the sky and the beasts of the earth will feed on your carcass. No one will scare them away.

public_domain_references.bsb: Your corpses will be food for all the birds of the air and beasts of the earth, with no one to scare them away.
public_domain_references.web: Your dead bodies will be food to all birds of the sky, and to the animals of the earth; and there will be no one to frighten them away.
public_domain_references.asv: And thy dead body shall be food unto all birds of the heavens, and unto the beasts of the earth; and there shall be none to frighten them away.
public_domain_references.kjv: And thy carcase shall be meat unto all fowls of the air, and unto the beasts of the earth, and no man shall fray [them] away.
public_domain_references.brenton: And your dead men shall be food to the birds of the sky, and to the beasts of the earth; and there shall be none to scare them away.

pob.text: Yahweh will strike you with the boils of Egypt[a], and with tumors, and with scabs, and with itch, from which you cannot be healed.

spob.text: Yahweh will strike you with the boils of Egypt, tumors[a], scabs, and an itching skin disease. You will not be able to be healed from them.

public_domain_references.bsb: The LORD will afflict you with the boils of Egypt, with tumors and scabs and itch from which you cannot be cured.
public_domain_references.web: Yahweh will strike you with the boils of Egypt, with the tumors, with the scurvy, and with the itch, of which you can not be healed.
public_domain_references.asv: Jehovah will smite thee with the boil of Egypt, and with the emerods, and with the scurvy, and with the itch, whereof thou canst not be healed.
public_domain_references.kjv: The LORD will smite thee with the botch of Egypt, and with the emerods, and with the scab, and with the itch, whereof thou canst not be healed.
public_domain_references.brenton: The Lord smite thee with the botch of Egypt in the seat, and with a malignant scab, and itch, so that thou canst not be healed.

pob.text: Yahweh will strike you with madness and blindness and confusion of heart[a].

spob.text: Yahweh will strike you with madness, blindness, and confusion in your heart.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: The LORD will afflict you with madness, blindness, and confusion of mind,
public_domain_references.web: Yahweh will strike you with madness, with blindness, and with astonishment of heart.
public_domain_references.asv: Jehovah will smite thee with madness, and with blindness, and with astonishment of heart;
public_domain_references.kjv: The LORD shall smite thee with madness, and blindness, and astonishment of heart:
public_domain_references.brenton: The Lord smite thee with insanity, and blindness, and astonishment of mind.

pob.text: And you will grope at noon as the blind gropes in the darkness[a], and you will not prosper in your ways; and you will be only oppressed and robbed all the days[c][b], with no one to save you.

spob.text: At noon, you will grope around like a blind man in the dark. Nothing you do will prosper. Day after day, you will suffer nothing but oppression and robbery, and no one will save you.

public_domain_references.bsb: and at noon you will grope about like a blind man in the darkness. You will not prosper in your ways. Day after day you will be oppressed and plundered, with no one to save you.
public_domain_references.web: You will grope at noonday, as the blind gropes in darkness, and you shall not prosper in your ways. You will only be oppressed and robbed always, and there will be no one to save you.
public_domain_references.asv: and thou shalt grope at noonday, as the blind gropeth in darkness, and thou shalt not prosper in thy ways: and thou shalt be only oppressed and robbed alway, and there shall be none to save thee.
public_domain_references.kjv: And thou shalt grope at noonday, as the blind gropeth in darkness, and thou shalt not prosper in thy ways: and thou shalt be only oppressed and spoiled evermore, and no man shall save [thee].
public_domain_references.brenton: And thou shalt grope at mid-day, as a blind man would grope in the darkness, and thou shalt not prosper in thy ways; and then thou shalt be unjustly treated, and plundered continually, and there shall be no helper.

pob.text: You will become engaged to a wife[a], but another man will lie with her; you will build a house, but you will not live in it; you will plant a vineyard[c][b], but you will not begin to use its fruit.

spob.text: You will become engaged to your future wife, but another man will have sex with her.[a] You will build a house, but you will not live in it. You will plant a vineyard, but you will not get to begin eating its fruit.[b]

public_domain_references.bsb: You will be pledged in marriage to a woman, but another man will violate her. You will build a house but will not live in it. You will plant a vineyard but will not enjoy its fruit.
public_domain_references.web: You will betroth a wife, and another man shall lie with her. You will build a house, and you won’t dwell in it. You will plant a vineyard, and not use its fruit.
public_domain_references.asv: Thou shalt betroth a wife, and another man shall lie with her: thou shalt build a house, and thou shalt not dwell therein: thou shalt plant a vineyard, and shalt not use the fruit thereof.
public_domain_references.kjv: Thou shalt betroth a wife, and another man shall lie with her: thou shalt build an house, and thou shalt not dwell therein: thou shalt plant a vineyard, and shalt not gather the grapes thereof.
public_domain_references.brenton: Thou shalt take a wife, and another man shall have her; thou shalt build a house, and thou shalt not dwell in it; thou shalt plant a vineyard, and shalt not gather the grapes of it.

pob.text: Your ox will be slaughtered before your eyes[a], but you will not eat any of it; your donkey will be seized from before you and will not be returned to you; your flock will be given to your enemies[b], and there will be no one to save you.

spob.text: Your ox will be slaughtered right in front of you, but you will not eat any of it. Your donkey will be seized right in front of you and never returned. Your flock will be handed over to your enemies, and no one will save you.

public_domain_references.bsb: Your ox will be slaughtered before your eyes, but you will not eat any of it. Your donkey will be taken away and not returned to you. Your flock will be given to your enemies, and no one will save you.
public_domain_references.web: Your ox will be slain before your eyes, and you will not eat any of it. Your donkey will be violently taken away from before your face, and will not be restored to you. Your sheep will be given to your enemies, and you will have no one to save you.
public_domain_references.asv: Thine ox shall be slain before thine eyes, and thou shalt not eat thereof: thine ass shall be violently taken away from before thy face, and shall not be restored to thee: thy sheep shall be given unto thine enemies, and thou shalt have none to save thee.
public_domain_references.kjv: Thine ox [shall be] slain before thine eyes, and thou shalt not eat thereof: thine ass [shall be] violently taken away from before thy face, and shall not be restored to thee: thy sheep [shall be] given unto thine enemies, and thou shalt have none to rescue [them].
public_domain_references.brenton: Thy calf [shall be] slain before thee, and thou shalt not eat of it; thine ass shall be violently taken away from thee, and shall not be restored to thee: thy sheep shall be given to thine enemies, and thou shalt have no helper.

pob.text: Your sons and your daughters will be given to another people[a], while your eyes look on and fail with longing for them all day long, but your hand will be powerless.

spob.text: Your sons and daughters will be given to another people. You will watch it happen, and your eyes will grow weak from longing for them all day long. But you will be powerless to do anything.

public_domain_references.bsb: Your sons and daughters will be given to another nation, while your eyes grow weary looking for them day after day, with no power in your hand.
public_domain_references.web: Your sons and your daughters will be given to another people. Your eyes will look and fail with longing for them all day long. There will be no power in your hand.
public_domain_references.asv: Thy sons and thy daughters shall be given unto another people; and thine eyes shall look, and fail with longing for them all the day: and there shall be nought in the power of thy hand.
public_domain_references.kjv: Thy sons and thy daughters [shall be] given unto another people, and thine eyes shall look, and fail [with longing] for them all the day long: and [there shall be] no might in thine hand.
public_domain_references.brenton: Thy sons and thy daughters shall be given to another nation, and thine eyes wasting away shall look for them: thine hand shall have no strength.

pob.text: A people whom you have not known will eat the fruit of your land and all your labor[b][a], and you will be only oppressed and crushed all your days.

spob.text: A people you have never known will eat the produce of your land and everything your work has produced. You will be oppressed and crushed without relief all your days.

public_domain_references.bsb: A people you do not know will eat the produce of your land and of all your toil. All your days you will be oppressed and crushed.
public_domain_references.web: A nation which you don’t know will eat the fruit of your ground and all of your work. You will only be oppressed and crushed always,
public_domain_references.asv: The fruit of thy ground, and all thy labors, shall a nation which thou knowest not eat up; and thou shalt be only oppressed and crushed alway;
public_domain_references.kjv: The fruit of thy land, and all thy labours, shall a nation which thou knowest not eat up; and thou shalt be only oppressed and crushed alway:
public_domain_references.brenton: A nation which thou knowest not shall eat the produce of thy land, and all thy labours; and thou shalt be injured and crushed always.

pob.text: And you will be driven mad by the sight your eyes see[a].

spob.text: What your eyes see will drive you mad.

public_domain_references.bsb: You will be driven mad by the sights you see.
public_domain_references.web: so that the sights that you see with your eyes will drive you mad.
public_domain_references.asv: so that thou shalt be mad for the sight of thine eyes which thou shalt see.
public_domain_references.kjv: So that thou shalt be mad for the sight of thine eyes which thou shalt see.
public_domain_references.brenton: And thou shalt be distracted, because of the sights of thine eyes which thou shalt see.

pob.text: Yahweh will strike you with severe boils on the knees and on the legs[a], from which you cannot be healed, from the sole of your foot to the crown of your head.

spob.text: Yahweh will strike you with severe boils on your knees and lower legs, from the soles of your feet to the top of your head. You will not be cured.

public_domain_references.bsb: The LORD will afflict you with painful, incurable boils on your knees and thighs, from the soles of your feet to the top of your head.
public_domain_references.web: Yahweh will strike you in the knees and in the legs with a sore boil, of which you cannot be healed, from the sole of your foot to the crown of your head.
public_domain_references.asv: Jehovah will smite thee in the knees, and in the legs, with a sore boil, whereof thou canst not be healed, from the sole of thy foot unto the crown of thy head.
public_domain_references.kjv: The LORD shall smite thee in the knees, and in the legs, with a sore botch that cannot be healed, from the sole of thy foot unto the top of thy head.
public_domain_references.brenton: The Lord smite thee with an evil sore, on the knees and the legs, so that thou shalt not be able to be healed from the sole of thy foot to the crown of thy head.

pob.text: Yahweh will bring you and the king whom you set over yourself to a nation that neither you nor your fathers have known[a], and there you will serve other gods[b], wood and stone.

spob.text: Yahweh will bring you and the king you appoint to rule over you to a nation that neither you nor your fathers have ever known.[a] There you will serve other gods made of wood and stone.

public_domain_references.bsb: The LORD will bring you and the king you appoint to a nation neither you nor your fathers have known, and there you will worship other gods—gods of wood and stone.
public_domain_references.web: Yahweh will bring you, and your king whom you will set over yourselves, to a nation that you have not known, you nor your fathers. There you will serve other gods of wood and stone.
public_domain_references.asv: Jehovah will bring thee, and thy king whom thou shalt set over thee, unto a nation that thou hast not known, thou nor thy fathers; and there shalt thou serve other gods, wood and stone.
public_domain_references.kjv: The LORD shall bring thee, and thy king which thou shalt set over thee, unto a nation which neither thou nor thy fathers have known; and there shalt thou serve other gods, wood and stone.
public_domain_references.brenton: The Lord carry away thee and thy princes, whom thou shalt set over thee, to a nation which neither thou nor thy fathers know; and thou shalt there serve other gods, wood and stone.

pob.text: And you shall become an object of horror[a], a proverb[c][b], and a taunt among all the peoples where Yahweh will drive you.

spob.text: You will become something horrifying—a proverb and a taunt—among all the peoples where Yahweh drives you.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: You will become an object of horror, scorn, and ridicule among all the nations to which the LORD will drive you.
public_domain_references.web: You will become an astonishment, a proverb, and a byword among all the peoples where Yahweh will lead you away.
public_domain_references.asv: And thou shalt become an astonishment, a proverb, and a byword, among all the peoples whither Jehovah shall lead thee away.
public_domain_references.kjv: And thou shalt become an astonishment, a proverb, and a byword, among all nations whither the LORD shall lead thee.
public_domain_references.brenton: And thou shalt be there for a wonder, and a parable, and a tale, among all the nations, to which the Lord thy God shall carry thee away.

pob.text: You will carry much seed out to the field[a], but you will gather in little, because the locust will consume it.

spob.text: You will take plenty of seed out to sow in the field, but you will bring in only a small harvest, because locusts will devour your crop.

public_domain_references.bsb: You will sow much seed in the field but harvest little, because the locusts will consume it.
public_domain_references.web: You will carry much seed out into the field, and will gather little in, for the locust will consume it.
public_domain_references.asv: Thou shalt carry much seed out into the field, and shalt gather little in; for the locust shall consume it.
public_domain_references.kjv: Thou shalt carry much seed out into the field, and shalt gather [but] little in; for the locust shall consume it.
public_domain_references.brenton: Thou shalt carry forth much seed into the field, and thou shalt bring in little, because the locust shall devour it.

pob.text: You will plant vineyards and cultivate them[a], but you will not drink the wine or gather it, because the worm will eat it.

spob.text: You will plant vineyards and tend them, but you will not drink their wine or bring in the harvest.[a] This is because worms will eat it.

public_domain_references.bsb: You will plant and cultivate vineyards, but will neither drink the wine nor gather the grapes, because worms will eat them.
public_domain_references.web: You will plant vineyards and dress them, but you will neither drink of the wine, nor harvest, because worms will eat them.
public_domain_references.asv: Thou shalt plant vineyards and dress them, but thou shalt neither drink of the wine, nor gather [the grapes]; for the worm shall eat them.
public_domain_references.kjv: Thou shalt plant vineyards, and dress [them], but shalt neither drink [of] the wine, nor gather [the grapes;] for the worms shall eat them.
public_domain_references.brenton: Thou shalt plant a vineyard, and dress it, and shalt not drink the wine, neither shalt thou delight thyself with it, because the worm shall devour it.

pob.text: You will have olive trees throughout all your territory[a], but you will not anoint yourself with oil, because your olives will fall off.

spob.text: You will have olive trees all across your land, but you will not be able to rub oil on your body, because your olives[a] will fall from the trees.

public_domain_references.bsb: You will have olive trees throughout your territory but will never anoint yourself with oil, because the olives will drop off.
public_domain_references.web: You will have olive trees throughout all your borders, but you won’t anoint yourself with the oil, for your olives will drop off.
public_domain_references.asv: Thou shalt have olive-trees throughout all thy borders, but thou shalt not anoint thyself with the oil; for thine olive shall cast [its fruit].
public_domain_references.kjv: Thou shalt have olive trees throughout all thy coasts, but thou shalt not anoint [thyself] with the oil; for thine olive shall cast [his fruit].
public_domain_references.brenton: Thou shalt have olive trees in all thy borders, and thou shalt not anoint thee with oil, because thine olive shall utterly cast [its fruit].

pob.text: You will father sons and daughters[a], but they will not remain yours[b], because they will go into captivity.

spob.text: You will father sons and daughters, but they will not remain yours because they will go into captivity.

public_domain_references.bsb: You will father sons and daughters, but they will not remain yours, because they will go into captivity.
public_domain_references.web: You will father sons and daughters, but they will not be yours, for they will go into captivity.
public_domain_references.asv: Thou shalt beget sons and daughters, but they shall not be thine; for they shall go into captivity.
public_domain_references.kjv: Thou shalt beget sons and daughters, but thou shalt not enjoy them; for they shall go into captivity.
public_domain_references.brenton: Thou shalt beget sons and daughters, and they shall not be [thine], for they shall depart into captivity.

pob.text: The cricket shall take possession of all your trees and the fruit of your ground[a].

spob.text: Crickets will take over all your trees and all the fruit your soil produces.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: Swarms of locusts will consume all your trees and the produce of your land.
public_domain_references.web: Locusts will consume all of your trees and the fruit of your ground.
public_domain_references.asv: All thy trees and the fruit of thy ground shall the locust possess.
public_domain_references.kjv: All thy trees and fruit of thy land shall the locust consume.
public_domain_references.brenton: All thy trees and the fruits of thy land shall the blight consume.

pob.text: The foreigner who is among you will rise higher and higher above you[a], and you will go down lower and lower.

spob.text: The foreigner living among you[a] will rise higher and higher above you, while you fall lower and lower.

public_domain_references.bsb: The foreigner living among you will rise higher and higher above you, while you sink down lower and lower.
public_domain_references.web: The foreigner who is among you will mount up above you higher and higher, and you will come down lower and lower.
public_domain_references.asv: The sojourner that is in the midst of thee shall mount up above thee higher and higher; and thou shalt come down lower and lower.
public_domain_references.kjv: The stranger that [is] within thee shall get up above thee very high; and thou shalt come down very low.
public_domain_references.brenton: The stranger that is within thee shall get up very high, and thou shalt come down very low.

pob.text: He will lend to you[a], but you will not lend to him; he will be the head[b], and you will be the tail.

spob.text: He[a] will lend to you, but you will not lend to him. He will be the head—the one in the higher position—and you will be the tail—the one in the lower position.

public_domain_references.bsb: He will lend to you, but you will not lend to him. He will be the head, and you will be the tail.
public_domain_references.web: He will lend to you, and you won’t lend to him. He will be the head, and you will be the tail.
public_domain_references.asv: He shall lend to thee, and thou shalt not lend to him: he shall be the head, and thou shalt be the tail.
public_domain_references.kjv: He shall lend to thee, and thou shalt not lend to him: he shall be the head, and thou shalt be the tail.
public_domain_references.brenton: He shall lend to thee, and thou shalt not lend to him: he shall be the head, and thou shalt be the tail.

pob.text: And all these curses will come upon you and pursue you and overtake you[a], until you are destroyed, because you did not listen to the voice of Yahweh your God, to keep his commandments and his statutes that he commanded you.

spob.text: All these curses will come upon you. They will pursue you and overtake you until you are destroyed. This will happen because you did not listen to the voice of Yahweh your God—that is, you did not keep the commandments and statutes he commanded you.

public_domain_references.bsb: All these curses will come upon you. They will pursue you and overtake you until you are destroyed, since you did not obey the LORD your God and keep the commandments and statutes He gave you.
public_domain_references.web: All these curses will come on you, and will pursue you and overtake you, until you are destroyed, because you didn’t listen to Yahweh your God’s voice, to keep his commandments and his statutes which he commanded you.
public_domain_references.asv: And all these curses shall come upon thee, and shall pursue thee, and overtake thee, till thou be destroyed; because thou hearkenedst not unto the voice of Jehovah thy God, to keep his commandments and his statutes which he commanded thee:
public_domain_references.kjv: Moreover all these curses shall come upon thee, and shall pursue thee, and overtake thee, till thou be destroyed; because thou hearkenedst not unto the voice of the LORD thy God, to keep his commandments and his statutes which he commanded thee:
public_domain_references.brenton: And all these curses shall come upon thee, and shall pursue thee, and shall overtake thee, until he shall have consumed thee, and until he shall have destroyed thee; because thou didst not hearken to the voice of the Lord thy God, to keep his commands, and his ordinances which he has commanded thee.

pob.text: And they will be on you and on your offspring as a sign and a wonder forever[a][b].

spob.text: They will be on you and your descendants as a sign and a wonder forever.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: These curses will be a sign and a wonder upon you and your descendants forever.
public_domain_references.web: They will be for a sign and for a wonder to you and to your offspring forever.
public_domain_references.asv: and they shall be upon thee for a sign and for a wonder, and upon thy seed for ever.
public_domain_references.kjv: And they shall be upon thee for a sign and for a wonder, and upon thy seed for ever.
public_domain_references.brenton: And [these things] shall be signs in thee, and wonders among thy seed for ever;

pob.text: because you did not serve Yahweh your God with joy and with gladness of heart[a], because of the abundance of all things[b],

spob.text: because you did not serve Yahweh your God with joy and a glad heart, even when you had an abundance of everything.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: Because you did not serve the LORD your God with joy and gladness of heart in all your abundance,
public_domain_references.web: Because you didn’t serve Yahweh your God with joyfulness and with gladness of heart, by reason of the abundance of all things;
public_domain_references.asv: Because thou servedst not Jehovah thy God with joyfulness, and with gladness of heart, by reason of the abundance of all things;
public_domain_references.kjv: Because thou servedst not the LORD thy God with joyfulness, and with gladness of heart, for the abundance of all [things;]
public_domain_references.brenton: because thou didst not serve the Lord thy God with gladness and a good heart, because of the abundance of all things.

pob.text: And you shall serve your enemies[a], whom Yahweh will send against you, in hunger and in thirst and in nakedness and in lack of everything[b]; and he will put an iron yoke on your neck until he has destroyed you.

spob.text: You will be forced to serve the enemies Yahweh sends against you. You will be hungry and thirsty, without clothes, and lacking everything. Yahweh will put an iron yoke on your neck until he destroys you.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: you will serve your enemies the LORD will send against you in famine, thirst, nakedness, and destitution. He will place an iron yoke on your neck until He has destroyed you.
public_domain_references.web: therefore you will serve your enemies whom Yahweh sends against you, in hunger, in thirst, in nakedness, and in lack of all things. He will put an iron yoke on your neck until he has destroyed you.
public_domain_references.asv: therefore shalt thou serve thine enemies that Jehovah shall send against thee, in hunger, and in thirst, and in nakedness, and in want of all things: and he shall put a yoke of iron upon thy neck, until he have destroyed thee.
public_domain_references.kjv: Therefore shalt thou serve thine enemies which the LORD shall send against thee, in hunger, and in thirst, and in nakedness, and in want of all [things:] and he shall put a yoke of iron upon thy neck, until he have destroyed thee.
public_domain_references.brenton: And thou shalt serve thine enemies, which the Lord will send forth against thee, in hunger, and in thirst, and in nakedness, and in the want of all things; and thou shalt wear upon thy neck a yoke of iron until he shall have destroyed thee.

pob.text: Yahweh will raise up against you a nation from far away[a], from the end of the earth[b], as the eagle swoops down—a nation whose language you will not understand.

spob.text: Yahweh will bring against you a nation from far away, from the ends of the earth. It will swoop down like an eagle. You will not understand its language.

public_domain_references.bsb: The LORD will bring a nation from afar, from the ends of the earth, to swoop down upon you like an eagle—a nation whose language you will not understand,
public_domain_references.web: Yahweh will bring a nation against you from far away, from the end of the earth, as the eagle flies: a nation whose language you will not understand,
public_domain_references.asv: Jehovah will bring a nation against thee from far, from the end of the earth, as the eagle flieth; a nation whose tongue thou shalt not understand;
public_domain_references.kjv: The LORD shall bring a nation against thee from far, from the end of the earth, [as swift] as the eagle flieth; a nation whose tongue thou shalt not understand;
public_domain_references.brenton: The Lord shall bring upon thee a nation from the extremity of the earth, like the swift flying of an eagle, a nation whose voice thou shalt not understand;

pob.text: a fierce-faced nation[c][b][a], one that shows no regard for the old and shows no favor to the young.

spob.text: a fierce-looking nation that shows no respect for old people and no kindness to young people.

public_domain_references.bsb: a ruthless nation with no respect for the old and no pity for the young.
public_domain_references.web: a nation of fierce facial expressions, that doesn’t respect the elderly, nor show favor to the young.
public_domain_references.asv: a nation of fierce countenance, that shall not regard the person of the old, nor show favor to the young,
public_domain_references.kjv: A nation of fierce countenance, which shall not regard the person of the old, nor shew favour to the young:
public_domain_references.brenton: a nation bold in countenance, which shall not respect the person of the aged and shall not pity the young.

pob.text: It will consume the offspring of your livestock and the produce of your land until you are destroyed; it will leave you no grain[a], new wine, or oil, no calves of your herd or lambs of your flock, until it has destroyed you.

spob.text: It will devour the young of your livestock and the crops from your land until you are destroyed. It will leave you no grain, new wine, or oil, and no calves from your herds or lambs[a] from your flocks, until it has destroyed you.

public_domain_references.bsb: They will eat the offspring of your livestock and the produce of your land until you are destroyed. They will leave you no grain or new wine or oil, no calves of your herds or lambs of your flocks, until they have caused you to perish.
public_domain_references.web: They will eat the fruit of your livestock and the fruit of your ground, until you are destroyed. They also won’t leave you grain, new wine, oil, the increase of your livestock, or the young of your flock, until they have caused you to perish.
public_domain_references.asv: and shall eat the fruit of thy cattle, and the fruit of thy ground, until thou be destroyed; that also shall not leave thee grain, new wine, or oil, the increase of thy cattle, or the young of thy flock, until they have caused thee to perish.
public_domain_references.kjv: And he shall eat the fruit of thy cattle, and the fruit of thy land, until thou be destroyed: which [also] shall not leave thee [either] corn, wine, or oil, [or] the increase of thy kine, or flocks of thy sheep, until he have destroyed thee.
public_domain_references.brenton: And it shall eat up the young of thy cattle, and the fruits of thy land, so as not to leave to thee corn, wine, oil, the herds of thine oxen, and the flocks of thy sheep, until it shall have destroyed thee;

pob.text: And he will besiege you in all your gates until your high and fortified walls, in which you trust, come down throughout all your land; and he will besiege you in all your gates throughout all your land that Yahweh your God has given you.

spob.text: He will lay siege to every one of your towns[a] throughout your land. The siege will continue until the high, fortified walls you trust in come down. He will lay siege to every one of your towns throughout the land Yahweh your God has given you.

public_domain_references.bsb: They will besiege all the cities throughout your land, until the high and fortified walls in which you trust have fallen. They will besiege all your cities throughout the land that the LORD your God has given you.
public_domain_references.web: They will besiege you in all your gates until your high and fortified walls in which you trusted come down throughout all your land. They will besiege you in all your gates throughout all your land which Yahweh your God has given you.
public_domain_references.asv: And they shall besiege thee in all thy gates, until thy high and fortified walls come down, wherein thou trustedst, throughout all thy land; and they shall besiege thee in all thy gates throughout all thy land, which Jehovah thy God hath given thee.
public_domain_references.kjv: And he shall besiege thee in all thy gates, until thy high and fenced walls come down, wherein thou trustedst, throughout all thy land: and he shall besiege thee in all thy gates throughout all thy land, which the LORD thy God hath given thee.
public_domain_references.brenton: and have utterly crushed thee in thy cities, until the high and strong walls be destroyed, in which thou trustest, in all thy land; and it shall afflict thee in thy cities, which he has given to thee.

pob.text: And you will eat the fruit of your womb[a], the flesh of your sons and daughters whom Yahweh your God has given you[b], in the siege and in the distress with which your enemy will oppress you.

spob.text: During the siege and the distress your enemy inflicts on you, you will eat the fruit of your womb—the flesh of your sons and daughters, whom Yahweh your God has given you.

public_domain_references.bsb: Then you will eat the fruit of your womb, the flesh of the sons and daughters whom the LORD your God has given you, in the siege and distress that your enemy will inflict on you.
public_domain_references.web: You will eat the fruit of your own body, the flesh of your sons and of your daughters, whom Yahweh your God has given you, in the siege and in the distress with which your enemies will distress you.
public_domain_references.asv: And thou shalt eat the fruit of thine own body, the flesh of thy sons and of thy daughters, whom Jehovah thy God hath given thee, in the siege and in the distress wherewith thine enemies shall distress thee.
public_domain_references.kjv: And thou shalt eat the fruit of thine own body, the flesh of thy sons and of thy daughters, which the LORD thy God hath given thee, in the siege, and in the straitness, wherewith thine enemies shall distress thee:
public_domain_references.brenton: And thou shalt eat the fruit of thy body, the flesh of thy sons and of thy daughters, all that he has given thee, in thy straitness and thy affliction, with which thine enemy shall afflict thee.

pob.text: The man who is tender among you and very delicate—his eye will be hostile toward his brother[a], toward the wife of his bosom[b], and toward the rest of his children whom he has left.

spob.text: The man among you who is tender and accustomed to great comfort will turn a hostile eye toward his brother,[a] the wife he holds close, and the rest of his children who remain.

public_domain_references.bsb: The most gentle and refined man among you will begrudge his brother, the wife he embraces, and the rest of his children who have survived,
public_domain_references.web: The man who is tender among you, and very delicate, his eye will be evil toward his brother, toward the wife whom he loves, and toward the remnant of his children whom he has remaining,
public_domain_references.asv: The man that is tender among you, and very delicate, his eye shall be evil toward his brother, and toward the wife of his bosom, and toward the remnant of his children whom he hath remaining;
public_domain_references.kjv: [So that] the man [that is] tender among you, and very delicate, his eye shall be evil toward his brother, and toward the wife of his bosom, and toward the remnant of his children which he shall leave:
public_domain_references.brenton: He that is tender and very delicate within thee shall look with an evil eye upon his brother, and the wife in his bosom, and the children that are left, which may have been left to him;

pob.text: so that he will not give to any of them any of the flesh of his sons that he is eating[a], because he has nothing left[b], in the siege and in the distress with which your enemy will oppress you within all your gates.

spob.text: He will refuse to share with any of them the flesh of his sons that he is eating, because he has nothing left. This will happen when your enemy besieges every one of your towns and causes you terrible distress.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: refusing to share with any of them the flesh of his children he will eat because he has nothing left in the siege and distress that your enemy will inflict on you within all your gates.
public_domain_references.web: so that he will not give to any of them of the flesh of his children whom he will eat, because he has nothing left to him, in the siege and in the distress with which your enemy will distress you in all your gates.
public_domain_references.asv: so that he will not give to any of them of the flesh of his children whom he shall eat, because he hath nothing left him, in the siege and in the distress wherewith thine enemy shall distress thee in all thy gates.
public_domain_references.kjv: So that he will not give to any of them of the flesh of his children whom he shall eat: because he hath nothing left him in the siege, and in the straitness, wherewith thine enemies shall distress thee in all thy gates.
public_domain_references.brenton: so as [not] to give to one of them of the flesh of his children, whom he shall eat, because of his having nothing left him in thy straitness, and in thy affliction, with which thine enemies shall afflict thee in all thy cities.

pob.text: The tender and delicate woman among you[a], who has not ventured to set the sole of her foot on the ground because of delicacy and tenderness, her eye will be evil toward the husband of her embrace[b], and toward her son and her daughter—

spob.text: The delicate, pampered woman among you—so delicate that she has never dared to let the sole of her foot touch the ground—will look with hostile, begrudging eyes at the husband she holds close, and at her son and daughter—

public_domain_references.bsb: The most gentle and refined woman among you, so gentle and refined she would not venture to set the sole of her foot on the ground, will begrudge the husband she embraces and her son and daughter
public_domain_references.web: The tender and delicate woman among you, who would not venture to set the sole of her foot on the ground for delicateness and tenderness, her eye will be evil toward the husband that she loves, toward her son, toward her daughter,
public_domain_references.asv: The tender and delicate woman among you, who would not adventure to set the sole of her foot upon the ground for delicateness and tenderness, her eye shall be evil toward the husband of her bosom, and toward her son, and toward her daughter,
public_domain_references.kjv: The tender and delicate woman among you, which would not adventure to set the sole of her foot upon the ground for delicateness and tenderness, her eye shall be evil toward the husband of her bosom, and toward her son, and toward her daughter,
public_domain_references.brenton: And she that is tender and delicate among you, whose foot has not assayed to go upon the earth for delicacy and tenderness, shall look with an evil eye on her husband in her bosom, and her son and her daughter,

pob.text: and toward her afterbirth that comes out from between her legs[a], and toward her children whom she bears, because she will eat them secretly, in the lack of everything[c][b], during the siege and distress with which your enemy will oppress you within your gates.

spob.text: She will even be hostile toward her afterbirth that comes out from between her legs[a] and toward the children she gives birth to, because she will secretly eat them when she has nothing at all. This will happen during the siege and distress your enemy inflicts on you inside your towns.

public_domain_references.bsb: the afterbirth that comes from between her legs and the children she bears, because she will secretly eat them for lack of anything else in the siege and distress that your enemy will inflict on you within your gates.
public_domain_references.web: toward her young one who comes out from between her feet, and toward her children whom she bears; for she will eat them secretly for lack of all things in the siege and in the distress with which your enemy will distress you in your gates.
public_domain_references.asv: and toward her young one that cometh out from between her feet, and toward her children whom she shall bear; for she shall eat them for want of all things secretly, in the siege and in the distress wherewith thine enemy shall distress thee in thy gates.
public_domain_references.kjv: And toward her young one that cometh out from between her feet, and toward her children which she shall bear: for she shall eat them for want of all [things] secretly in the siege and straitness, wherewith thine enemy shall distress thee in thy gates.
public_domain_references.brenton: and her offspring that comes out between her feet, and the child which she shall bear; for she shall eat them because of the want of all things, secretly in thy straitness, and in thy affliction, with which thine enemy shall afflict thee in thy cities.

pob.text: If you are not careful to do all the words of this law that are written in this book[c][b][a], to fear this glorious and awesome name—Yahweh your God—

spob.text: If you do not carefully obey everything this law says in this book, so as to fear[a] the glorious and awesome name—Yahweh your God[b]—

public_domain_references.bsb: If you are not careful to observe all the words of this law which are written in this book, that you may fear this glorious and awesome name—the LORD your God—
public_domain_references.web: If you will not observe to do all the words of this law that are written in this book, that you may fear this glorious and fearful name, YAHWEH your God,

“Yahweh, hear Judah’s voice
and bring him to his people.
Let his hands fight for him,[a]
and help him against his enemies.”
